cross_tier_signals.description: Tier A duplicate class and Tier B all five Basalt-bystander pairs agree; live explore_pair rejects all five post participant-gate. Frozen JSONL retains pre-gate inventory until baseline re-freeze (ROADMAP M4 item 5).

Tier B agrees all seven etb_damage_death-adjacent fixture pairs are invalid_candidate_data; Tier C reports family healthy on gold_core fixtures but engine_aligned=false because no real Oracle compiler path covers ETB ping or self-untap token loops.

Tier A flags valid_generic_prerequisite as doc-clear but engine-misaligned with zero frozen exemplars; Tier C core_breed_alarm demonstrates generic token fodder in gold_core excluded from extras pool; Tier B fixture token-breeder rows are invalid_candidate_data not valid_generic.

Tier A invalid_candidate_data and Tier B agree on all 16 fixture labels; seven fixture pairs still live-accepted post gate (strict_two_card verified). Exclusion is eval/metrics policy, not search filtering—intentional but creates frozen-vs-live count drift (16 frozen vs 10 live extras).
All three tiers align on zone_recursion_sacrifice: Tier A valid_strict_two_card (3 samples), Tier B 3/3 strict extras agree, Tier C family end-to-end healthy with witness-to-extra cross-map.

Four Tier A classes have zero frozen gold-pool exemplars (valid_generic_prerequisite, functional_external_requirement, unjustified_initial_state, needs_rules_research). Tier B cannot calibrate pair-level disagreement for these buckets; process debt for reviewer training and baseline coverage.

Tier B agrees invalid_candidate_data for oracle:basalt-monolith__oracle:self-untap-tapper but notes frozen witness marked Basalt unused while live explore_pair now finds strict two-card Basalt+Perpetual loop—witness staleness, not label error. Re-freeze should refresh participation metadata.
